page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with the printed page number and running head at the top. Left and right margins are empty. Below the last line is a gathering signature at the centre and a catchword at the right. Faint show-through from the other side is not transcribed.

main_text.p: confuetis, actiones has quam atrociffime infectatu-ros ; & (quandoquidem commentum illud de summa facilitate conficiendi Scotos, ab ipfis Anglis explofum confpexiffent) ad alias artes fe converfuros, ac juraturos, prodere jam fœderatos manifefta rebellionis figna, quâ religionis fucata larva hactenus velarunt, eos proftituere ac tantum non conculcare majeftatem regiam, nec intra defenfionis limites iis ftatutum fefe continere, notiora effe illa à rege ferenifs.Scotis fœderatis objecta edicto illo Februarii 27. quam quæ negari aut excufatione ulla dilui poffent; Scriptum ediderunt fœderati quo ad edictum illud, & fingula ejus capita fufe refpondent, præcedentium fuarum actionum æquitatem demonstrant, ac ab omnibus in edicto objectis vindicant,Defenfionem hanc fuam armatam licitam docent, & ideoque interceptionem hanc arcium & caftellorum legitimam imo neceffariam fuiffe, cum medium fit ad defenfionem fimpliciter neceffarium. Etenim fi liceat rem alienam, ex qua ingens & certum mihi imminet periculum, citra alienæ culpæ confiderationem invadere, & cuftodire donec fecuritati meæ cautum fit; cur non (inquiebant) liceat collectivo regni corpori contra armatam vim legitime fe tuenti, arces & fortalitia à majoribus fuis[?] intra regnum condita, ut effent propugnacula contra externos hoftes, intercipere? Cum præfens & ingens ab iis tati regno intentetur periculum: Scriptum vero illud de verbo fere in verbum tranflatum fic fe habet.

page.notes: Printed words read as given. "tati" is printed as such and is probably a misprint for "toti", left unchanged. "fuis" ends with a letter that may be a capital S; it is marked [?]. "ferenifs" has a long-s form that could also be read as f; it is given as s. "intercipere?" and "Scriptum" are printed as shown. The catchword "RE-" and the signature "X" were read from the foot of the page. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
